entry.summary:
Ever wondered where Kiwi athletes, their whanau, and supporters congregated during the Commonwealth Games? | Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/RNZVideo?sub_confirmation=1

NZ Olympic Team head of events Sarah Thorpe takes RNZ on a tour of NZ House - based out of an iconic 164-year-old converted church called Oran Mor in Glasgow's west end.

🎵 Universal Music 

More Commonwealth Games coverage: https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/sport
